notes.title: 🛠 Update notes for April 3rd
notes.content:
- Card "Strike of Genius" has been tweaked so the drawn card cannot be immediately discarded
- The end game screen should now scale properly on non 16/9 screens

notes.title: 🛠 Update notes for March 31st
notes.content: - A bug causing the "BOOM!!!" card to not hit elite enemies has been resolved
